ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan - Grains（中世日本 - 穀類）
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Ancient & Medieval Japan - Grains, initial release 0.1.0.
Adds dry-field grains, harvesting and processing, flour milling, and basic grain foods inspired by pre-Edo Japan. Also integrates the former Crop Growth Balance's six Vanilla crop growth settings and seven MO-conditional source adjustments. Some MO crops, including lentils, are no longer available for normal sowing under Agriculture's historical crop-selection patches, although their Def identifiers remain for compatibility. A separate Crop Growth Balance Mod is no longer needed. Mixed grain meals, grain porridge and mixed flour foods can combine leftover cereals; four ingredient-specific flour dishes give a small mood and storage advantage. Brown rice is used in common grain meals and porridge, while two dedicated dishes use polished white rice. Medieval Overhaul is required and provides the wheat, flour, millstone, straw and other existing medieval foundations reused by AMJ's food crop and processing changes. AMJG-owned crop and processing settings take precedence where explicitly specified.
Medieval Overhaul is required. Earlier Vanilla-only fallback source is retained for compatibility/history but is not a supported standalone release profile. Crop Cold Tolerance Overhaul remains optional. Adaptive Primitive Storage is strongly recommended, not required, for granary bulk storage; the original granary and baskets keep Hay construction costs, while optional MO Straw-built variants can be selected separately when MO is present. New Village is provided exclusively by the separate AMJ Scenarios mod; Grains contains no starting scenario.
Release status: Prior RimWorld 1.6 grain-processing and cooking checks covered historical Vanilla, CCTO and MO profiles; the newly declared MO-required package has not received a fresh end-stage native acceptance. Known unchanged external MO/SYR audio errors are excluded from Grains acceptance. The initial private Workshop upload, subscriber-build verification and final publication decision are still pending.
Ancient & Medieval Japan - Grains 初回公開版0.1.0。
江戸以前の日本を参考に、畑作穀類、収穫と加工、製粉、基本的な穀物料理を追加する。旧Crop Growth Balanceのバニラ6種・MO併用時の7定義の生育日数調整も統合した。ただし、MOレンズ豆など時代適合性から通常栽培を除外した作物もあり、旧定義の識別子は互換性のため維持する。Crop Growth Balanceの別途導入は不要。余った穀類を混ぜて使える飯・粥・粉食があり、4種類の材料指定粉食は心情・保存性で有利になる。玄米は共通の飯・粥に使用し、白米専用の白飯・白粥を用意する。Medieval Overhaul（MO）を必須の生産基盤とし、小麦・粉・石臼・藁など既存資産を再利用する。AMJ側が責務を持つ作物と加工の確定設定を優先する。
Medieval Overhaulは必須。旧Vanilla単独用フォールバックのソースは保管するが、今後の単独リリース対応は対象外。Crop Cold Tolerance Overhaulは任意。Adaptive Primitive Storageは穀倉で穀物を大量収納できるため併用を強く推奨するが、必須ではない。元の穀倉と編み籠は干し草を使用し、MO併用時は藁で建築する別の選択肢も追加する。新しい村シナリオは別ModのAMJ Scenariosだけが提供する。Grainsには開始シナリオを含めない。
公開準備状況：過去のRimWorld 1.6実ゲーム検証はVanilla・CCTO・MO構成で実施。今回のMO必須依存に変更後の最終実機受入は未実施。Grainsが変更していないMO/SYR由来の既知音声エラーは公開判定から除外。Workshopへの初回非公開アップロード、配布版確認、一般公開の最終判断は未実施。
Dining: AMJ Dining is required; it currently requires Harmony and Daily Menu. Hungry pawns combine stored staple food with available soup and a side into one meal tray. AMJ Dining owns meal assembly and Daily Menu compatibility. Generic simple-meal cooking Bills are retired; saved Def references remain. See Docs/Dining.md for setup and evidence limits.
献立・配膳：AMJ Diningが必須。Diningは現在HarmonyとDaily Menuを使用する。備蓄した主食に汁・副食を取り合わせて一膳にまとめる。一膳化とDaily Menu互換処理はDiningが提供する。汎用の簡単な食事の新規調理Billは停止し、旧Defは維持する。仕様・使い方・検証範囲はDocs/Dining.mdを参照。
